hero.description: It started with a simple problem. One family. One moment. One realization that trust is the hardest thing to find when you need it most.

origin.title: A Family's Need
origin.quote: A foreign family was preparing to travel home for a few months. But their life in Kigali couldn't simply be locked away and left behind.
origin.p1: They had a cat that needed daily care. A home that needed oversight. Regular cleaning to coordinate. Vehicles that needed occasional check-ins and engine starts to stay in good condition while they were away.
origin.p2: Finding someone they could genuinely trust turned out to be much harder than expected.
origin.p3: Running out of options, they reached out to someone they barely knew, simply because they felt they had no other choice. What they needed wasn't just a pet sitter or someone to stop by occasionally. They needed someone dependable who could step in, pay attention to details, and care for things as if they were their own.
origin.p4: Fortunately, that support was found. And it changed everything.

spark.title: The Spark
spark.questionEmphasis: What about the many people who aren't fortunate enough to find trusted help through chance or personal connections?

reality.p1: Busy professionals. Families. Expats. People moving to a new country. They all face the same challenge: needing reliable support from someone they can truly trust.
reality.p2: For those settling into Kigali, how much easier would life feel with a dependable person to help navigate a new environment, rather than relying entirely on internet searches and uncertainty?

mission.title: Making Kigali easier to live in, one trusted connection at a time.

whatWeDo.p: We remove friction from everyday life by helping people find dependable support without the guesswork.

howItFeels.p: Calm, personal, and practical. Like having someone local in your corner when life gets busy or unfamiliar.

vision.title: A concierge culture rooted in ease, trust, and local knowledge.
vision.p: We want lifestyle support in Rwanda to feel less transactional and more like a reliable relationship people can return to.

ease.p: Simple requests. Clear follow-through. Less friction.

trust.p: Dependable help that feels steady, not random.
